description: Na₆Mg₂Nb₄Si₆(SO₁₂)₃ crystallizes in the trigonal P3c1 space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.97 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.48 Å) and three longer (2.78 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.52 Å) and three longer (2.63 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.57 Å) and three longer (2.67 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Mg sites. In the first Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra and corners with three equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (2.07 Å) and three longer (2.10 Å) Mg-O bond lengths. In the second Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra and corners with three equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (1.95 Å) and three longer (2.31 Å) Mg-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent Nb sites. In the first Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra and corners with three equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (1.89 Å) and three longer (2.19 Å) Nb-O bond lengths. In the second Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (1.94 Å) and three longer (2.11 Å) Nb-O bond lengths. In the third Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (1.96 Å) and three longer (2.01 Å) Nb-O bond lengths. In the fourth Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra and corners with three equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (1.90 Å) and three longer (2.18 Å) Nb-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one MgO₆ octahedra and corners with three NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 25-37°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.56-1.69 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one MgO₆ octahedra and corners with three NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 21-40°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.60-1.69 Å. S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two MgO₆ octahedra and corners with two NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 17-38°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.46-1.53 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mg, and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one Nb and one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Mg and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one Nb, and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one Nb, and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one Nb, and one Si atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Mg, and one Si atom to form distorted ONa₃MgSi trigonal bipyramids that share corners with three equivalent ONa₃NbSi trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃NbSi trigonal bipyramid, and faces with two equivalent ONa₃MgSi trigonal bipyramids. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one Nb, and one Si atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mg, and one S atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Nb, and one Si atom to form distorted ONa₃NbSi trigonal bipyramids that share corners with three equivalent ONa₃MgSi trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃MgSi trigonal bipyramid, and faces with two equivalent ONa₃NbSi trigonal bipyramids. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Nb, and one Si atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Nb, and one S atom.
